extraction.parent_department: Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services

findings.title: Award determinations were not always made timely.
findings.description: CICB did not make award determinations in a timely manner. Review of case files for 20 payments totaling $224,000 disclosed that 6 awards totaling $76,000 had delays ranging from 37 to 321 days beyond the 90-day statutory limit.

dollar_amounts.context: review of case files for award payments
6 awards had delays beyond statutory limit

findings.recommendation: We recommend that CICB make award determinations within 90 days, as required.

extraction.agency_response_summary: The report states that the response from DPSCS, on behalf of CICB, to the finding and recommendation is included as an appendix to this report.
